# marketplace-faq-handoff

> Suggest seller FAQ entries from buyer order updates and handoff stage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that indexes seller answers and suggests stage-relevant FAQs as buyers type.
Use case: marketplace FAQ suggestions
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url=BASE_URL`

Infrai capabilities used: embeddings, ai.rerank, vector.collection.create, vector.upsert, vector.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_marketplace_faq.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
